battle.name: 屋大維戰爭
battle.theater: 亞克興海灣至亞歷山大港
battle.brief: 年份欄記作前87年，與史實交戰年份有出入：實際戰事起於前43年第二次三頭同盟的分裂，終於前31年亞克興海戰與前30年亞歷山大城破。卡面的埃及月牙劍此時已退為王宮庫房的禮器，屬於被征服的埃及一方，而非征服者手上的短劍。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 屋大維戰爭是羅馬共和國末期的最後一場內戰，交戰集中在公元前43年至前30年，戰線由意大利、馬其頓與希臘一路延伸到埃及亞歷山大港。一方是屋大維一方：公元前43年11月第二次三頭同盟成立時，他與馬可·安東尼、雷必達共同取得非常統治權，屋大維分得意大利、西班牙、高盧、阿非利加、西西里與薩丁尼亞科西嘉，安東尼分得馬其頓、希臘、小亞細亞、敘利亞，並在前40年布倫迪西翁條約後獲得五年的東方統帥權。屋大維的軍隊核心是公民兵團與拉丁同盟盟軍，輔助兵力由高盧、西班牙與多瑙河上游的騎兵填補；安東尼的軍隊則是經過穆蒂納、菲利皮與帕提亞遠征的老兵軍團，兵源混合羅馬公民、意大利募兵、希臘雇兵與加拉太亞人。另一方是安東尼與埃及托勒密王朝的聯合體：克莉奧佩脫拉七世以自己的艦隊與尼羅河的資源支撐安東尼，亞歷山大城既是作戰基地，也是托勒密王室的權力核心。托勒密常備軍以馬其頓方陣為骨架，配備長槍方陣兵、輕裝步兵歐佐諾伊、塔倫丁小馬騎兵與弓箭手；安東尼一方另有西西里叛軍殘部、帕提亞戰役後歸降的散兵，以及在埃及待命的四個安東尼軍團。戰事分三段：對布魯圖斯與卡西烏斯的菲利皮戰役、屋大維在西西里對安東尼同黨的清剿，最後是公元前31年亞克興海戰與前30年的埃及戰役。
countriesEn: The War of Octavian was the last civil war of the Roman Republic, fought between 43 and 30 BC over a theatre that ran from Italy, Macedonia and Greece all the way to Alexandria in Egypt. One side was Octavian's: when the Second Triumvirate was constituted in November 43 BC, he shared the extraordinary powers with Mark Antony and Lepidus, taking Italy, Spain, Gaul, Africa, Sicily and Sardinia with Corsica, while Antony received Macedonia, Greece, Asia Minor and Syria, and after the Treaty of Brundisium of 40 BC the five-year command of the East. The core of Octavian's army was the citizen legions together with the contingents of the Latin League, with auxiliary troops supplied by cavalry from Gaul, Spain and the upper Danube. Antony's army was made of veteran legions hardened at Mutina, Philippi and in the Parthian expedition, its ranks a mixture of Roman citizens, Italian recruits, Greek mercenaries and Galatians. The other side was the alliance between Antony and the Ptolemaic dynasty of Egypt: Cleopatra VII supported Antony with her own fleet and with the resources of the Nile, and Alexandria was both a base of operations and the seat of Ptolemaic kingship. The Ptolemaic standing army was built around the Macedonian phalanx, with sarissa-armed pikemen, light infantry such as the Euzonoi, Tarentine cavalry riding small horses, and archers; Antony's side also drew on the remnants of the Sicilian revolt, men who surrendered after the Parthian campaign, and the four Antonian legions still mustered in Egypt. The war unfolded in three phases: the war against Brutus and Cassius at Philippi, Octavian's liquidation of Antony's partisans in Sicily, and finally the Battle of Actium in 31 BC and the Egyptian campaign of 30 BC.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的人不多，但每一位都直接握有艦隊或軍權。屋大維（Gaius Octavius，後稱奧古斯都）以凱撒遺囑執行人的身份回到意大利，依靠退伍老兵與公民兵團的支持立住腳跟；他在穆蒂納、菲利皮與佩魯西亞三役中都沒有佔到便宜，最後的取勝來自海戰與持久戰裡的耐心。馬可·安東尼是元老院中最有軍力的人，貴族出身、能征慣戰，自公元前43年起掌握東方行省；前36年遠征帕提亞雖告失敗，他仍保住龐大的東方軍力與稅源，前40年娶屋大維之妹屋大維婭以維繫同盟，前37年送她回國之後，兩人之間再也沒有妥協的空間。阿格里帕（Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa）是屋大維海戰的實際指揮者：前36年在西西里海峽的瑙洛庫斯海戰中擊敗塞克斯圖斯·龐培，前31年又在亞克興海戰破掉安東尼與克莉奧佩脫拉的聯合艦隊。克莉奧佩脫拉七世是托勒密王朝的末代女王，掌軍、掌財、掌外交，她在亞克興用自己的旗艦接應安東尼，兵敗後退回埃及，最後在亞歷山大城破城之日自盡。布魯圖斯與卡西烏斯代表弒父派的自由派路線，在菲利皮兵敗自盡；安東尼麾下的魁圖斯·拉比恩努斯在意大利牽制屋大維，兵敗後退入高盧，直到前36年才被迫放棄。埃及方面的索西烏斯是安東尼留在亞歷山大的守將，見大軍逼近而投降。帕提亞的國王阿爾達萬二世與其子帕科魯斯在前36年擊敗安東尼的遠征軍，改變了東方的力量平衡。今日重建這段戰史的主要依據，是普布利烏斯、蘇埃托尼烏斯與阿庇安的記述。
peopleEn: The men who decided this war were few, but each of them held either a fleet or an army. Octavian (Gaius Octavius, later Augustus) came back to Italy as the executor of Caesar's will and built his position on discharged veterans and the citizen levy; he gained nothing at Mutina, Philippi or Perusia, and his eventual victory came from naval power and from patience in a long war. Mark Antony was the strongest military man in the senate, a patrician of long campaigning experience, and from 43 BC he held the eastern provinces. His Parthian expedition of 36 BC failed, but he still kept a large eastern army and a secure tax base; the marriage to Octavia in 40 BC was meant to hold the alliance together, and after sending her back in 37 BC there was no longer any room for compromise between the two men. Agrippa (Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa) was the real commander of Octavian's fleets: he destroyed Sextus Pompey at Naulochus in the Sicilian straits in 36 BC, and in 31 BC broke the combined fleet of Antony and Cleopatra at Actium. Cleopatra VII, the last queen of the Ptolemaic line, commanded troops, money and diplomacy; she supported Antony with her fleet, received his flagship at Actium, and after the defeat returned to Egypt, where she killed herself on the day the city fell. Brutus and Cassius headed the Liberators and died by their own hand after Philippi. Quintus Labienus, Antony's commander in Italy, held Octavian off at the gates of Rome and then fell back into Gaul, where he held out until 36 BC. Sosius, who commanded Antony's garrison at Alexandria, surrendered as the Roman army closed in. In the East, the Parthian king Artabanus II and his son Pacorus destroyed Antony's expedition in 36 BC and shifted the balance of power. The reconstruction of this war today rests mainly on the accounts of Plutarch, Suetonius and Appian.
kits: 卡面這把埃及月牙劍（Khopesh）在這場戰爭裡的位置，其實是一則反證：它是埃及最古老也最有代表性的冷兵器，形制是外彎的單刃，刃口開在內側，斬擊之後不必像直劍那樣拔插，但到公元前三世紀，它早已不是野戰裝備。托勒密王朝的王室武器庫與神廟祭祀仍保存並展示這類月牙刃，菲萊與埃德夫神廟的浮雕上，托勒密國王手持月牙劍擊敗敵人，那是王權儀式的一部分；真正上陣的埃及方陣兵用的是馬其頓式長槍與小圓盾，托勒密宮廷另設銀盾兵的名號，那是榮譽頭銜而非野戰編制，埃及的實戰刃器則是柄短、彎度不大的賽赫姆式彎刀，以及隨安東尼作戰的加拉太亞人帶來的高盧式長劍。卡面這件兵器在尼羅河宮廷中的真實用途更接近典禮佩劍與衛兵儀仗，而不是陣前搏殺。屋大維一方完全看不見月牙劍：羅馬軍團裝備的是短直劍與長劍（spatha）、標槍（pilum）、大盾（scutum）、分段式鐵甲（lorica segmentata）與青銅盔，騎兵用長劍與短刀（parazonium），海軍備有撞角、鷹爪抓鉤與手砲（harpax）壓制敵艦側舷，攻城仍使用扭力弩砲（onager）這類器材。埃及最後的艦隊在亞歷山大港自焚，說明托勒密王朝的裝備體系已無法與羅馬海軍競爭。
kitsEn: The position of the Egyptian khopesh on this card is, in fact, a piece of counter-evidence. It is the oldest and most characteristic cold weapon of Egypt, shaped as an outward-curving single blade with the cutting edge on the inside, so that a stroke does not have to be pulled free the way a straight sword must be, but by the third century BC it was no longer a field weapon at all. The royal armoury of the Ptolemies and their temple ritual still preserved and displayed blades of this kind: on the reliefs at Philae and Edfu the Ptolemy king is shown smiting his enemies with a khopesh, which belongs to the liturgy of kingship. The phalangites who actually fought carried the Macedonian sarissa and a small round shield; the Ptolemaic court additionally maintained a title of silver-shield guards, which was an honour rather than a field unit; the practical Egyptian blades were the short, gently curved sekhem-type sword, together with the long Celtic sword brought in by the Galatian allies of Antony. In the Nile court the weapon on this card functioned closer to a ceremonial sword and a guard's parade arm than to a tool of close combat. On Octavian's side the khopesh is entirely absent: the Roman legions carried the short straight sword and the longer spatha, the pilum, the scutum, segmented plate armour and bronze helmets; the cavalry used the spatha and the parazonium; the fleet carried rams, grappling irons and the harpax to work against the enemy's flanks; and sieges were still supported by torsion artillery such as the onager. The last Egyptian fleet burned itself in the harbour of Alexandria, which shows that the equipment system of the Ptolemaic state could no longer compete with the Roman navy.
tactics: 亞克興的戰法，是整場戰爭最具教科書意義的一段。前31年9月2日，安東尼把艦隊列成一道弧形，企圖以大型戰船壓過屋大維的直線陣，護住通向亞克興堡壘與阿姆布拉科斯灣的退路；克莉奧佩脫拉的船隊編在右翼外側，準備一旦旗艦受損便接人突圍。屋大維與阿格里帕採取的恰恰相反：主力艦排成帶缺口的一字長線，缺口讓小型的利布爾納快艇可以穿梭騷擾敵軍翼端，再用火船與投射兵器消耗對方箭矢；安東尼的弧形陣在海灣入口處被迫拉直，翼端受地形限制，縱深無法展開。交戰中一陣風令海面平靜，安東尼的旗艦與克莉奧佩脫拉的船隻脫離陣位，右翼失去掩護，艦隊隨即崩散；普布利烏斯記下真正的沉船數其實不多，多數是逃散與失落。阿格里帕追到亞細亞沿岸才收兵，屋大維則切斷安東尼的退路，迫殘部退入埃及。前30年的埃及戰役換了場地：羅馬軍隊在三角洲登陸後進軍亞歷山大，先在城外野地與安東尼的殘軍交鋒，再沿城牆推進，最終在城內街巷逐屋爭奪，這時攻城器械幾乎無用，靠的是羅馬軍團的密集縱隊與盾牌遮蔽。安東尼的軍隊在城破前夜失去大部分兵力，羅馬軍進入王宮區，索西烏斯投降，安東尼與克莉奧佩脫拉相繼自盡。
tacticsEn: The fighting at Actium is the most textbook-like passage of the whole war. On 2 September 31 BC Antony formed his fleet into an arc, intending to use his larger ships to overwhelm Octavian's straight line while covering the line of retreat towards the fort of Actium and the Ambracian Gulf; Cleopatra's squadron was placed outside the right wing, ready to take aboard Antony's flagship and break out should it be damaged. Octavian and Agrippa did the opposite: the heavy ships were drawn up in a single long line with gaps, so that small Liburnian galleys could slip through and trouble the wings of the enemy, and fire-ships and missiles were used to blunt the weight of the opposing missiles; Antony's arc was straightened by the narrow entrance to the gulf, its wings restricted by the shallows and unable to deploy in depth. During the engagement the wind dropped and the water went flat, Antony's flagship and Cleopatra's vessels lost their stations, the right wing lost its cover, and the fleet came apart; Plutarch records that few ships were actually sunk, most having simply scattered or gone missing. Agrippa broke off pursuit off the coast of Asia, and Octavian closed Antony's road home, driving the remnants into Egypt. The Egyptian campaign of 30 BC changed the setting entirely: the Roman army landed in the Delta and marched on Alexandria, first meeting Antony's remnants in the open ground outside the city, then working along the walls, and finally fighting house by house in the streets of the city. Siege artillery was of little use there; what carried the assault was the density of the Roman column and the shelter of the shields. Antony's troops lost most of their strength on the eve of the breach, the Romans entered the royal quarter, Sosius surrendered, and Antony and Cleopatra killed themselves in turn.
data: 古代數字多為追述，須當心誇大，但仍可作量級參考。屋大維在公元前43至前42年間於意大利整軍，蘇埃托尼烏斯記載他一度擴編到六十個軍團，阿庇安記下的兵力約為十二萬步兵與一萬二千騎兵。菲利皮一役，弒父派方面的兵力常被記為八萬餘人，三頭同盟聯軍約十二萬人上下；安東尼的遠征帕提亞損失慘重，帕科魯斯陣亡，安東尼僅率數千人退回安條克。亞克興海戰是數字分歧最大的地方：普布利烏斯記安東尼一方約五百艘船、二十萬人，屋大維一方約二百五十艘船、八萬人；現代學者一般認為屋大維的艦隊規模在三百至四百艘之間，安東尼的軍隊可能不足八萬人，但安東尼的戰船確實更大、裝甲更厚，操舟者多為老練水手。普布利烏斯記載海戰後約有一萬二千人脫離安東尼陣營投向屋大維；安東尼退入埃及時只剩四個軍團，多已士氣崩潰。戰役全程約十三年，亞克興至亞歷山大港直線距離一千五百公里上下。埃及被併入羅馬之後，亞歷山大港每年運往羅馬的穀物以數十萬計的阿爾塔巴為單位（一阿爾塔巴約合六十公升），這座城市從此是帝國的糧倉。
dataEn: Ancient figures are mostly retrospective and have to be treated with caution, but they still give the order of magnitude. While he was reorganising in Italy between 43 and 42 BC, Octavian expanded his army, Suetonius says, to as many as sixty legions, and Appian puts the strength at about 120,000 infantry and 12,000 cavalry. At Philippi the Liberators' forces are commonly given as a little over 80,000 men against roughly 120,000 for the triumviral coalition. Antony's Parthian expedition was ruinous: Pacorus was killed and Antony returned to Antioch with only a few thousand men. Actium is the point where the numbers diverge most sharply; Plutarch gives Antony about five hundred ships and two hundred thousand men, and Octavian about two hundred and fifty ships and eighty thousand men. Modern scholarship generally places Octavian's fleet somewhere between three hundred and four hundred ships and Antony's army below eighty thousand, but Antony's ships really were larger and more heavily armoured, and many of their crews were experienced hands. Plutarch records that some twelve thousand men deserted Antony's camp to Octavian after the battle, and that only four legions followed Antony back into Egypt, most of them already broken in spirit. The war as a whole ran for about thirteen years, and the direct distance from Actium to Alexandria is something like fifteen hundred kilometres. Once Egypt was absorbed into the Roman orbit, the grain that reached Rome from Alexandria was measured in hundreds of thousands of artabas a year (an artaba is roughly sixty litres), and the city became the granary of the empire.
cause: 打起來的原因有兩層。第一層是共和國的制度已經撐不住三巨頭的權力。凱撒遇刺後，執政官與保民官西庇阿與安東尼曾試圖用特權處理安東尼的軍權，屋大維則以凱撒遺囑執行人的名義自利比亞返回意大利，靠退伍老兵逼元老院承認他的地位；公元前43年11月第二次三頭同盟取得非常統治權，隨即以公佈名單清洗反對派，安東尼在前42年奪下東方行省，此後兩人各以一方國土經營自己的勢力。前37年安東尼送回屋大維婭，前36年遠征帕提亞失利卻仍握有龐大軍力，前35至前34年間他連續在安條克與亞歷山大城贈送巨額土地與財富給克莉奧佩脫拉，並於前34年在埃及加冕，公開挑戰屋大維只做執政官的定位：羅馬的兩位三頭同盟者之一成了埃及的法老。第二層是前32年帕提亞與羅馬議和，安東尼的東方霸權再沒有外敵可制；屋大維隨後以恢復共和國、懲罰弒父者與三頭同盟違憲為名，要求瓜分安東尼的軍隊與行省，於是西西里戰役中以海軍取勝、在埃及取勝，把安東尼的整個亞洲體系收為己有。
causeEn: There were two layers of cause. The first was that the institutions of the Republic could no longer carry the weight of three men's power. After Caesar's assassination the consuls and the tribunes, Scipio and Antony, tried to handle Antony's army by special privilege, while Octavian returned from Libya to Italy as the executor of Caesar's will and used discharged veterans to force the senate to recognise his position; the Second Triumvirate took the extraordinary powers in November 43 BC and immediately followed them with proscription lists against opponents, while Antony seized the eastern provinces in 42 BC, after which each man ruled his own half of the world as a personal power. Antony sent Octavia home in 37 BC; his Parthian expedition failed in 36 BC but left him a large army; between 35 and 34 BC he made successive grants of enormous land and wealth to Cleopatra at Antioch and at Alexandria, and in 34 BC he was crowned in Egypt, openly challenging Octavian's position as a Roman magistrate holding office only as consul: one of the two members of the Roman triumvirate had become a Pharaoh of Egypt. The second layer was that in 32 BC Parthia made peace with Rome, and Antony's eastern ascendancy no longer had an external enemy to hold it in check. Octavian then demanded the partition of Antony's army and provinces on the stated ground of restoring the republic and punishing the assassins and the unconstitutional acts of the triumvirate, and he won the Sicilian war at sea and the war in Egypt, taking Antony's whole Asian system for himself.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果，是埃及的資源與地中海世界的權力重心一次性轉移到羅馬。公元前30年之後，托勒密王朝的領土成為羅馬的埃及行省，尼羅河的穀物、亞歷山大的港口與藏書、托勒密宮廷的財寶全部被屋大維掌握並陸續運回意大利；阿格里帕得以在羅馬興建萬神殿、阿格里帕引水道與奧斯提亞港，屋大維本人則以戰利品建起奧古斯都廣場與恩澤祠，並把軍隊整編為二十八個常備軍團，取代共和國時代不斷徵募又遣散的臨時軍制。政治上，屋大維在前27年以第一次執政官的身分重整權力，元老院與人民大會的形式仍在，實際決策卻集中於一人，共和國最後一絲平衡就此消失，羅馬進入史上所稱的奧古斯都和平時期，以地中海世界的長期安定換取約兩個世紀的內部平穩。東北方則留下新的隱患：帕提亞並未被削弱到不能反擊，安東尼的殘部與被留下來的王室成員在埃及以外繼續活動；羅馬自此自覺是東方強國的對手，也第一次把疆域與責任延伸到幼發拉底河以外。
impactEn: The outcome of this war was a single transfer of Egypt's resources and of the centre of gravity of the Mediterranean world to Rome. After 30 BC the territory of the Ptolemies became the Roman province of Egypt, and the grain of the Nile, the harbour and the library of Alexandria and the treasure of the Ptolemaic court all passed into Octavian's hands and were shipped to Italy piece by piece. Agrippa was thereby able to build the Pantheon, the Aqua Virgo and the harbour of Ostia, and Octavian himself raised the Forum of Augustus and the Ara Pacis out of the booty, while reorganising the army into twenty-eight standing legions in place of the constant levy and dismissal of the republican system. Politically, Octavian recast his power as consul for the first time in 27 BC; the forms of the senate and the popular assemblies survived, but actual decision-making was concentrated in one man, and the last balance of the Republic disappeared. Rome entered what is called the Augustan peace, trading the long calm of the Mediterranean for roughly two centuries of internal stability. In the East new problems remained: Parthia was not weakened to the point of being unable to answer, Antony's remnants and the surviving members of the royal house carried on their lives outside Egypt, and Rome now considered itself the rival of the eastern powers, extending its borders and its obligations for the first time beyond the Euphrates.

resultEn: On 2 September 31 BC the battle in the Ambracian Gulf ended in a complete victory for Octavian; the following summer Antony's remnants were driven out of Alexandria, Cleopatra VII and Mark Antony killed themselves in turn, the six centuries of the Ptolemaic dynasty came to an end, and Egypt became a Roman province, administered with Syria by men Octavian could trust. Octavian allowed none of Antony's units to be reconstituted: Antony's officers either surrendered or died, the cities of Greece and Asia Minor were required to pay heavy fines and to give hostages, and Octavian's own veterans were rewarded with discharge and land, the army being settled at twenty-eight standing legions. The children Antony and Cleopatra left behind were turned into marriages and hostages: their daughter Cleopatra Selene was married to Juba II of North Africa, and their son Ptolemy was settled in Mauretania, Rome's way of managing what was left of Egypt through marriage and client kings. Octavia, Octavian's sister, returned to Rome with her young son. After the war the history of Rome was no longer the shuffling of factions in the Republic: from Sulla to Caesar every crisis had still been capable of being reshuffled by the desertion of some legion, but this time there was no room for reversal, because the opponent was not a Roman but a dynasty that Romans already regarded as a foreign enemy. From then on Rome drew its frontiers across other people's land.
